argument: Chapter 10 fails as a publishable unit: six defects, two of them contradictions inside the chapter's own spine, and the rest completeness or notation breaks against the chapters that implement the framework. First, the sentence at [10-magic-system:65] declares that Discipline prerequisites admit no substitutions, but the shipped Odd signature Eccentric Spellcasting (ch05:287, ch02:301, ch21:81) exempts exactly two chosen abilities, one arcane and one divine, from those prerequisites while level gates still bind, and ch13:498-500 plays that exemption out at the table. Broken value [10-magic-system:65]: the absolute no-substitution claim. Expected: the same sentence qualified by that named exception. Violated convention: a framework chapter may not deny a class signature the rest of the book ships; the brief names this exact contradiction a defect. Minimal fix: add the exception clause naming Eccentric Spellcasting, and route the identical blanket claim at ch08:265 out of this micro-PR. Second, [10-magic-system:29] promises no concentration roll, while [10-magic-system:115] orders a Fortitude check to sustain concentration after damage. Broken value [10-magic-system:115]: the mandatory maintenance check. Expected: one concentration rule, not two. Violated convention: the one-roll principle, which line 29 itself states. Minimal fix: either delete the check or qualify line 29. Third, the worked example at [10-magic-system:133] prints 15 as a centre bonus on an Adept card whose row is 6/9/12, so the bonus leaves the row; ch11:136-147 and the sample card at ch19:567-573 print no such bonus. Broken value: 15. Expected: a value on the Adept row, or a rider phrased as one damage tier up. Violated convention: the damage budget is flat and keyed to the card's rank. Minimal fix: drop the 15 or restate it as '+1 damage tier'. Fourth and fifth, the tradition blocks at [10-magic-system:99] and [10-magic-system:101] are incomplete against ch11 and ch12: arcane cards key to Mind (5 cards) and Plants (1 card, ch11:280), the divine chapter keys one card to Plants (ch12:330), and ch05:507/526 places the Intellect in the Mage ability pool beside the Arcanist. Broken values: the five-discipline arcane list and the four-discipline divine list. Expected: complete lists or an explicit non-exhaustive note. Minimal fix: add Mind, Plants and the Intellect, or mark both lists illustrative. Sixth, [10-magic-system:74] writes the Master prerequisite as '1 Fire, rank 3' while the same column writes '1 Fire' for Novice and '2 Fire' for Adept two rows up, and ch08:208 renders a Fire-only Master requirement as three ranks of Fire. Broken value: '1 Fire, rank 3'. Expected: '3 Fire'. Violated convention: a card's tier equals its Discipline-rank count, and notation must match ch08. Minimal fix: print '3 Fire'. Disposition tiers: defects 1 and 2 are substantive cross-chapter corrections, defect 3 is mechanical and local to the example, defects 4-6 are one-line completeness or notation edits. Everything else in the chapter verified clean, so the fix is bounded, not a rewrite.

evidence.claim: [10-magic-system:65] denies any Discipline-substitution wildcard, but the shipped Odd signature (ch05:287, ch02:301, ch21:81) exempts exactly two chosen abilities, one arcane and one divine, from prerequisite Disciplines while level gates still bind, and ch13:498-500 uses that exemption to cast a Fire spell with no Fire Discipline. Expected: the absolute claim qualified by that exception. Minimal fix: name Eccentric Spellcasting as the sole exception; the same blanket claim at ch08:265 is routed out of this micro-PR. Violated convention: a shipped class signature cannot be denied by the framework chapter.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: There are no wildcard Discipline substitutions.

evidence.claim: Internal contradiction across two printed lines: [10-magic-system:29] states the system has no concentration roll at all, while [10-magic-system:115] requires a Fortitude check to sustain a concentration spell after taking damage. Broken value: the Fortitude check mandated at line 115. Expected: a single consistent rule. Minimal fix: either delete the maintenance check at 115 or qualify the absolute statement at 29. Violated convention: one-roll principle, the casting roll already fixes the outcome.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: no separate casting check, no concentration roll

evidence.claim: The worked example at [10-magic-system:133] gives 15 damage near the centre of an Adept Brimstone Burst whose printed row is 6/9/12, so Strong is 12; 15 is the Master row's Strong value. Canon card text at ch11:136-147 and the card sample at ch19:567-573 print no centre bonus. Broken value: 15. Expected: a number on the Adept row, or a rider written as one damage tier up. Minimal fix: delete the 15 or rephrase as '+1 damage tier'. Violated convention: the damage budget is flat and keyed to the card's rank, and an off-row centre bonus is a defect.
